lead_raw_text:
The structure of TiNi2Ge2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 15-atom unit cell (Ti3Ni6Ge6) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 9 neighbors, Ni centers with 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, and Ti centers with 16 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ge and Ni polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ge and Ti polyhedra.
